manaNeeded: {5} minus {X}, where X is Devoted Druid's toughness minus one
notablePrerequisites:
Haldir has at least six +1/+1 counters on it.
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
If Devoted Druid has toughness 2 or greater, activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat steps 1 and 2 until Devoted Druid has toughness equal to 1.
Activate Haldir by paying {5}{G}, giving Elves you control +1/+1 until end of turn for each +1/+1 counter on Haldir.
If Devoted Druid is tapped, activate its second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
